name: E-Rickshaw Kalyan Yojana
benefit:
- Under this scheme, loans are provided to unemployed youth for the purchase of e-rickshaws at an annual interest rate of 9%. Additionally, under the Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana, savings account holders receive an insurance cover of ₹2.00 lakh for an annual premium of ₹12/-. 
  - Beneficiaries aged between 18 and 50 can also avail benefits under the Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant should be currently unemployed. - The applicant must possess a valid driving license. - The applicant must not be more than 55 years of age.
